slice_id: F5a / P7 slice 3 / same-domain dynamic P4 capture authority
adr: ADR-0143 - same-domain dynamic P4 capture authority
proposal: Adds a second, one-shot instance of the existing final _SyntheticP4CapturedAuthorizationAuthority class (unchanged, not subclassed) bound to a new _DynamicP4TrustedArtifactResolver constructed only from a retained ADR-0141 _SyntheticRootPisIssuer.graph() (ADR-0142 NonAuthorizingDynamicRootGraph). The resolver re-derives and re-proves the ADR-0141 signed two-root PIS and the ADR-0142 12-artifact graph snapshot/resolve vector on every snapshot()/resolve() call inside the existing commit_p4_batch locked critical section, using the shared reserve_meta now_ms clock and live revocation snapshot (not the fixed 500-ms clock or fixed revocation digest). The shared _p4_require_issued_authority/_p4_snapshot_integrity identity gates are extended from a single hardcoded resolver type to a closed two-member if/elif/else dispatch with unconditional refusal for any third type, so the legacy fixed authority/resolver pairing stays byte-identical and structurally cannot observe dynamic-graph bytes. A new, narrowly-scoped root-capture-admission/cas/pce chain, sized to exactly the two PIS entries, is proposed via a new _dynamic_p4_close_admission closure walk that is never called by and never edits the existing v1-only _p4_close_admission.
scope: Design proposal only: new resolver/terminal-verifier/clock/revocation classes, a second same-class P4 authority instance, an extended (not replaced) identity-gate dispatch table, one new reserve_uses kind ('dynamic-p4-authority') on the unchanged 4-table WAL/FULL schema, and a new minimal admission-chain schema (dskit.root-capture-admission/v1) plus its own closure-walk function. No production code, tests, or fixtures were written or edited in this call.
non_goals: Full EventEnvelope.v2 causality/ordering/provenance/correction semantics; composed-tape verification; reuse or extension of the fixed scope-intent/gate-evidence/scope-authorization/stage-admission historical-study apparatus for the dynamic domain; Packet 8 durable consume-once; deployment; any edit to the fixed P4 corpus, its 500-ms clock, _FixedWormTrustedArtifactResolver, _FixedTerminalArtifactVerifier, or _p4_close_admission's v1-only grammar.
open_questions_for_reviewer: commit_p4_batch's inherited _FixedP4Signer/_P4_VERIFICATION captured-port/receipt/set signing infrastructure and its issued_at_ms=500/expires_at_ms=1000 decision-receipt stamps are proposed as shared, unedited nondeployment fixture metadata for both the legacy and dynamic authority instances, since the real temporal gate lives in the resolver's own fresh graph re-proof. Reviewer should confirm this reading is acceptable or require a live-clock-stamped decision receipt for the dynamic path instead.

the exact root-capture-admission/cas/pce document shapes and the full _dynamic_p4_close_admission dependency table are sketched but explicitly left for Phase 0 to pin or correct, consistent with how ADR-0135/0136/0138 left comparable wiring to Phase 0.

whether a one-use spend on dynamic authority construction (proposed reserve kind='dynamic-p4-authority') is the right granularity, versus also rate-limiting or scoping individual CAPTURED batches beyond the existing per-stream/per-document/per-run checks already inherited from _validate_capture_request/commit_p4_batch.
code_changed: none; docs/architecture/decision-log.md and this evidence file only
gate: Proposal only. Independent preapproval review and owner ADR approval required before Phase 0. Phase 0 (required for this trust-boundary-crossing, effecting-capability slice per docs/skills/skeptic-review.md) must complete with zero Critical/Major before RED. No RED/GREEN, no two-final-lens review, and no merge to main have occurred.

majors: signed_id reuse ambiguity across kinds: Decision point 9 proposed the new kind='dynamic-p4-authority' reserve row using the SAME canonical {bootstrap_id,authorization_id} signed_id text as ADR-0141's kind='root-pis' row in the shared (kind,signed_id)-primary-keyed reserve table, which the reviewer read as a possible double-spend surface on the original signed authorization (funding two independent one-shot admissions from one original signed pair, with no closed argument in the ADR for why that is safe).

adr0143_preapproval_review.correction: ADR-0143 Decision point 9 now derives the dynamic-p4-authority row's signed_id from the retained root-pis row's own stored identity (_digest over that row's own signed_id text plus its own intent_sha256, read back from the already-ISSUED row) instead of reusing the original {bootstrap_id,authorization_id} pair text; this makes the row constructible only downstream of an already-ISSUED root-pis row, with an explicit closed argument that the original signed pair still funds exactly one thing directly (one root-pis issuance, spent exactly once, unchanged from ADR-0141) and the dynamic-p4-authority row is a second, independently one-shot construction gated on that issuance's prior existence, not a parallel draw on the same pair. The 'Reserve reuse' bullet in the construction profile was updated to match and now states the reservation is refused inside its own BEGIN IMMEDIATE if the corresponding root-pis row is not already ISSUED. Decision point 4 now spells out the exact 'if type(resolver) is _FixedWormTrustedArtifactResolver: ... elif type(resolver) is _DynamicP4TrustedArtifactResolver: ... else: raise/refuse' shape for both _p4_require_issued_authority (else: TypeError("exact broker-issued P4 capability is required"), matching trust.py's existing exception) and _p4_snapshot_integrity (else: _hs_refuse(False, "P4 snapshot integrity refused"), matching trust.py's existing ValueError raised via _hs_refuse), states neither function may gain a third branch, default case, or shared permissive dispatch helper without a new reviewed ADR, and clarifies _P4_RESOLVER_CLASSES is only the closed set the two elif arms are checked against, never a permissive membership test used in place of the explicit branches. A new 'Open questions (for Phase 0)' subsection was added listing (1) the shared fixed-signer receipt-stamp question and (2) the authority-construction-granularity one-use question, and the dangling Decision point 6 cross-reference now names that subsection. Re-verified against dskit/pipeline/trust.py on this branch (no code edited) that _p4_require_issued_authority raises TypeError("exact broker-issued P4 capability is required") and _p4_snapshot_integrity's resolver-type check raises ValueError("P4 snapshot integrity refused") via _hs_refuse, so the ADR's else-arm exception text now matches today's code exactly.
